answer.reason: The verses tell of Ben-hadad's attack on Israel at Asa's request, his siege of Samaria and his sparing by Ahab.

clauses.english: attacked Ijon, Dan and other cities of Israel at Asa's request
clauses.quote: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa

clauses.english: besieged Samaria with thirty-two kings and all his host
clauses.quote: he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it

clauses.english: was spared by Ahab after his defeat at Aphek, and made a covenant with him
clauses.quote: So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

doubts: Left out 1KI 22:31, 2KI 5:5, 2KI 6:8, 2KI 6:11 and 2CH 18:30: they name only an unnamed king of Syria, who may not be this Ben-hadad.
Left out 2KI 6:24 and 2KI 8:7-9: the Ben-hadad there may be a different king of that name, and 2KI 8:7-9 give only his sickness, not his death.
Left out 1KI 20:3-10 (the demands on Ahab): they are the steps of the siege already given as one clause.
